description: Run a retrieval-augmented query against a channel's indexed knowledge base and return a generated answer with citations. Maps to POST /v1/query. Requires the key's `query` scope and access to the channel. Charged: $0.02 flat per call by default. Prices are the service defaults; `quote` returns the exact price.

channel_id.description: Channel to query. The key must be scoped to it.

source_types.description: Restrict retrieval to these source types.

name: query_channel
title: Query a channel
